capabilities: Link to folders by adding a trailing slash to internal links
Reveal an existing folder in the navigation when its link is clicked
Create the folder when a link points to a non-existing folder
Style resolved and unresolved folder links
Show folder links in outgoing links and graph view
disambiguation: Not a folder-notes tool: clicking a folder link only reveals the folder in the navigation, it does not open a folder index view.
extras: README warns that renaming or moving an already linked folder will not update existing folder links for now; includes an extension ideas section inviting feature suggestions.
intentEvidence: This plugin adds a frequently requested feature to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian internal links can only resolve to files, so linking to a folder to reveal it in the file navigation is not possible.
summary: Plugin that makes internal links ending in / point to folders, revealing the folder in navigation or creating it on click.
